patterns.symptom: Infinite switching between /login and /studio after Stripe checkout
patterns.rootCause: Signed-in user receives activationStatus needs_sign_in when Stripe fails; studio redirects to login despite valid session
patterns.repairStrategy: Only redirect to login when signedIn=false; use activation_pending for signed-in failures; resolvePostAuthRedirect honors session_id before onboarding pricing path

patterns.symptom: After login user lands on /pricing instead of studio with session_id
patterns.rootCause: login.js prioritized onboarding next.path before getPostAuthRedirectPath next query
patterns.repairStrategy: hasPaidCheckoutPending blocks onboarding pricing; pass session_id to onboarding API

patterns.symptom: Cached auth/pricing/studio pages cause routing loops after deploy
patterns.rootCause: SW served stale HTML navigation fallback
patterns.repairStrategy: SW version bump; mustBypassHtml for /login /studio /pricing /success; clear old resumora-shell caches on checkout routes; API routes network-only
redirectedRef single-flight; prefetch checkout-complete before studio redirect

patterns.symptom: checkoutReady false on production; activation never completes
patterns.repairStrategy: Manual Render env: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET; verify /api/health checkoutReady true
